items.claim: Tresean Gore showed the ability to overcome adversity and make the fight ugly in his last performance.
items.quote: he was going through adversity and he'll come back and he'll make it ugly. Like he was fighting hard in that fight and I remember being impressed by him.

items.claim: Vicente Luque is very dangerous with submission threats when opponents make a mistake or get dropped.
items.quote: if you slip or like you make a mistake or Luke drops you, he the way he grabs the neck is just so good. So is a Luke K sub's very possible

items.claim: Vicente Luque does not have a great offensive wrestling game and relies on opponents making mistakes to capitalize.
items.quote: Luk's offensive wrestling isn't even all that great. It's like how he It's like how he gets he just finds moments though, you know? It's not like he shoots a lot of takedowns and actually scores.

items.claim: Tresean Gore consistently gets rocked in his fights.
Vicente Luque possesses significant knockout power.
